Graphic Design Studio v0.3.2

Record notes

Twelve design methods with production helpers, a four-tool MCP runtime, presentations, plotting and pet workflows.

Version 0.3.2 includes 12 complete skill procedures. Complete design methods and original production runtime; retained Apache pet workflow; optional providers remain external.

Requirements: Python 3.12 and declared dependencies for local runtime; Design Templates for optional chooser; Host image tools for generation.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add graphic-design-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 7d32c283e34098403c5ffdacbeee7bed57a4ac8f. SHA-256: a37bd4b8ccf958d3e0bc51ed1d267a7e789d857d7e0f45f72e5fbf4a6a319054.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
